gold_assessment.reasoning: Generated cc-001 notes numbness and tingling in the left arm and fingers; this captures numbness of the left arm, although it omits duration (2 weeks) and adds tingling. Core complaint of left arm numbness is present.

Therefore this is actually not explicitly covered.
